ruleDefinitions.name: Bitsadmin to Uncommon TLD
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Bitsadmin connections to domains with uncommon TLDs Note: Unmapped fields: c-useragent, cs-host

sequences.query: c-useragent = RGX("^Microsoft\\ BITS\\/") AND  NOT ((cs-host = RGX("\\\.com$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.net$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.org$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.scdn\\\.co$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.sfx\\\.ms$")))
